method: built-in image_gen; identity-preserving expression edits; originals retained
review_scope: Root visually inspected each output. Identity and costume retained; more focused S. Wayne, laughing Steezo, competitive Wa Bidi. Not human art acceptance.

characters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: H.E.X. in-game detailed champion portrait. Image 1 is the existing S. Wayne edit target. Preserve his exact dark brown skin, curly black hair, Hobbit pointed ears, adult youthful face identity, purple and gold coat, burgundy cravat, parchment background, square chest-up composition and hand-crafted retro pixel clusters. Change the generic friendly smile into the poised personality of a nimble Dark/Light boundary tactician: observant eyes looking slightly sideways as if measuring an opening, one subtly questioning brow, lips closed in a small thoughtful asymmetric expression rather than a broad grin, shoulders relaxed, chin slightly lowered. He should look intelligent, reserved, quietly amused and charming, not evil or cold, not a generic anime hero. More expressive face planes and readable silhouette, clean consistent pixel art with restrained palette and readable features at 128px. No new props, no hands, no weapons, no spells, no text, no border, no watermark. Preserve identity, skin tone and costume; expression and restrained head posture are the meaningful changes. Fully opaque parchment background; generous head/ear clearance.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: H.E.X. in-game detailed champion portrait. Image 1 is the existing Steezo edit target. Preserve this male goblin's lime-olive skin, broad long ears, tousled brown hair, brass goggles with blue lenses, practical brown leather and cream shirt, square chest-up crop and warm parchment background. His playstyle is a quick small-body Charge/Fire/Light pressure skirmisher. Replace the generic closed smirk with an infectious reckless tinkerer personality: genuine open-mouthed delighted laugh showing a couple irregular small teeth, eyes crinkling with excitement, expressive uneven eyebrows, head slightly cocked forward as if a risky experiment just worked. Confident, scrappy and endearing rather than vicious; an adult goblin, not infant or modern cartoon mascot. Keep exact race and identity, no new equipment, no raised hands or props. Crisp charming retro pixel illustration, chunky intentional pixel clusters, readable face at 128px, controlled highlights and texture consistent with the target. No spells, elemental symbols, text, border, logo or watermark. Preserve costume and colours and head clearance; change expression and subtle posture only.
